'''Jolien''' was a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' from the [[Salt Flat]] sept and the [[Nakai]] clan.

== Appearance ==
She was blue eyed with red gold hair. 

== Activities ==
She was among the first [[Aiel]] to cross the [[Spine of the World]] in a quest for the ''[[Car'a'carn]]''. She met [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] while on their way to [[Tear]] and was present when Nynaeve heals [[Dailin (maiden)|Dailin]] from an injury.{{ref/book|3|38}}

She was one of the Aiel who helped [[Rand al'Thor]] capture the [[Stone of Tear]].

She, along with [[Adelin]] and [[Enaila]], shaved [[Isendre]] bald and beat her with nettles after catching her again trying to sneak into Rand's bed in [[Eianrod]], [[Cairhien]].

She followed Rand from [[Tear]] to the battle of [[Cairhien]] where she died.
